appDesc.message: Save selected text, links, or whole web pages to Cognify on your computer. Nothing is sent to the internet.

introUnpaired.message: Connect this extension to Cognify on your computer.

step2.message: Turn on Browser extension, then press Make code.

hintContext.message: You can also use the right-click menu, or keyboard shortcuts in your browser's extension settings.

offlineText.message: Cognify is not connected. Open Cognify and make sure Settings → Data → Browser extension is on.

footer.message: Everything stays on this computer. Nothing is sent to the internet.

savedSticky.message: Now a floating note in Cognify.

savedAppend.message: Added to the page in Cognify.

onlyWeb.message: Only web pages (http/https) can be saved.

noSelection.message: Select some text on the page first.

notPaired.message: Pair the extension first: click the Cognify icon in the toolbar.

pageTooBig.message: This page is too big to save.

pageEmpty.message: This page has no content to save.

notConnected.message: Cognify is not connected. Open Cognify and turn on Settings → Data → Browser extension.

err_forbidden_origin.message: This request did not come from the extension.

err_forbidden_host.message: The bridge address is not recognized.

err_unauthorized.message: The extension is not paired. Click the Cognify icon to connect.

err_pair_invalid.message: Wrong code, or none made in Cognify yet.

err_pair_expired.message: The code has expired. Make a new one in Cognify.

err_pair_locked.message: Too many wrong tries. Make a new code in Cognify.

err_exists.message: This page is already saved in Cognify.

err_not_found.message: The target page no longer exists. Pick another.

cmdSaveSticky.message: Make a floating note in Cognify

err_too_fast.message: Saving too fast. Wait a moment and try again.

err_invalid_pdf.message: This PDF can't be read (it may be locked), but highlights can still be saved.

pdfFailed.message: But the PDF data couldn't be read ($REASON$); complete the source in Cognify.
